lines.beaver: 지금 역 앞이에요. 수진 씨는 어떤 모습이에요?
lines.beaver_en: I'm in front of the station now. What does Sujin look like?
lines.beaver_roman: jigeum yeogapieyo. sujin ssineun eotteon moseubieyo?
lines.learner: 키가 크고 얼굴이 예뻐요. 머리는 조금 셌어요.
lines.en: She's tall and has a pretty face. Her hair is a little gray.
lines.roman: kiga keugo eolguri yeppeoyo. meorineun jogeum sesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Her hair is gray? Is she old?
lines.en: No, she's still young. But it looks cool.

lines.learner: 빨간색 코트를 입었어요. 그래서 잘 보여요.
lines.en: She's wearing a red coat. So she's easy to spot.
lines.roman: ppalgansaek koteureul ibeosseoyo. geuraeseo jal boyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 아, 저분인가? 손에 뭐 들고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, is that her? Is she holding anything?
lines.beaver_roman: a, jeobuninga? sone mwo deulgo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 화장품 가게 쇼핑백을 들고 있을 거예요.
lines.en: She'll be holding a cosmetics shop bag.
lines.roman: hwajangpum gage syopingbaegeul deulgo isseul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 화장품 가게요? 수진 씨는 무슨 일을 해요?
lines.beaver_en: A cosmetics shop? What does Sujin do?
lines.beaver_roman: hwajangpum gageyo? sujin ssineun museun ireul haeyo?
lines.learner: 미용실에서 일해요. 그래서 멋을 잘 내요.
lines.en: She works at a hair salon. So she dresses really well.
lines.roman: miyongsireseo iraeyo. geuraeseo meoseul jal naeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, so does she do her own hair too?
lines.en: Yes, but she doesn't dye it.

lines.beaver: 그런데 수진 씨는 왜 염색을 안 해요?
lines.beaver_en: But why doesn't Sujin dye her hair?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde sujin ssineun wae yeomsaegeul an haeyo?
lines.en: Her gray hair looks cool, so she leaves it.

lines.beaver_en: Would I look cool with gray hair too? Just kidding.
lines.en: Haha, you have a nice face, so you'd be fine.

lines.beaver: 아, 빨간 코트! 저기 뛰어가는 분이에요?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, a red coat! Is it the woman running over there?
lines.beaver_roman: a, ppalgan koteu! jeogi ttwieoganeun bunieyo?
lines.learner: 네, 아마 그 사람이 수진 씨일 거예요.
lines.roman: ne, ama geu sarami sujin ssiil kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I'll go say hello now.
lines.learner: 네, 수진 씨랑 맛있는 거 드세요!
lines.en: Okay, enjoy something tasty with Sujin!
lines.roman: ne, sujin ssirang masinneun geo deuseyo!
